styles.label: ✏️ White Doodle
styles.direction: UNIVERSAL WHITE DOODLE STYLE — suitable for any product category. Treat the user's supplied product image(s) as the visual source of truth whenever provided; use written product details only as supporting context; omit unsupported labels. First reveal the complete, unchanged product. Draw thin white handwritten 2D linework progressively around only the visible silhouette and verified details: adapt the drawing to the object's actual outline and structure, whether it is clothing, a bag, footwear, cosmetics, food, electronics, home goods, accessories, tools or another product. Use one or two small arrows or sparkles only when they point to a genuinely visible detail; never cover the product, readable branding or important features. Keep product geometry, colors, labels, quantities, proportions and visible parts consistent. Part 1: clean reveal, one verified detail, restrained doodle accent, then HOLD the final frame in a stable full-product composition for the Part 2 handoff; Do not draw the main surrounding contour in Part 1; do not complete it yet. Part 2: resume from the same framing, progressively trace a thin white dashed contour around the actual visible silhouette, hold briefly, then return to a clean full-product hero finish. Graphics are flat 2D overlays, not physical objects, captions or UI. Never invent unseen sides. Do not invent unseen features, materials, accessories, claims, prices, popularity or text. Never guess a category, benefit, price, popularity or product name. Do not force a product-specific action that the reference does not support.

styles.label: 🎬 Cinematic Premium
styles.direction: Premium realistic commercial: soft key light, restrained highlights, natural shadows, slow camera push, consistent product and environment.

styles.label: ✨ Minimal Motion Graphic
styles.direction: Bright uncluttered product framing, subtle geometric accent lines and smooth minimal graphic reveals, elegant spacing and gentle motion.

styles.label: ⚡ Dynamic Affiliate
styles.direction: Engaging but controlled affiliate pacing: striking opening crop, feature emphasis with clean graphic accents, smooth match cuts and clear final hero shot.

styles.label: 💎 Luxury Product
styles.direction: Refined dark or neutral luxury lighting, soft rim highlights, rich material texture, sophisticated slow movement, elegant product-focused closing.

styles.label: 📱 Mirror Selfie
styles.direction: Authentic handheld smartphone mirror-selfie aesthetic. Use a consistent person, outfit, mirror viewpoint, phone and room throughout the shot. Use only small natural movements such as a gentle posture shift or slight phone adjustment; no outfit changes, exaggerated posing or invented people.

styles.label: 🌿 Everyday Lifestyle
styles.direction: Natural candid lifestyle commercial in a believable everyday setting that suits the visible product. Soft daylight, relaxed human pacing, realistic contact and subtle camera drift. Do not invent product functions, extra accessories or unnecessary people.

styles.label: 🗣️ UGC Creator Review
styles.direction: Friendly creator-style product demonstration with authentic phone-camera framing and natural room light. Focus on showing the exact visible item and one or two real visible details; gestures stay simple and plausible. No fabricated testimonials, claims, ratings, prices or spoken words unless explicitly supplied.

styles.label: 👗 Fashion Editorial
styles.direction: Polished fashion-campaign framing with confident but natural posing, tasteful full-length and detail compositions, soft directional light and refined color grading. Preserve the exact garment, pattern placement, fit, accessories and visible person; no wardrobe changes or invented garment details.

styles.label: ✨ Beauty & Macro Detail
styles.direction: Elegant beauty-ad close-ups with controlled highlights, shallow but purposeful depth of field and slow macro-style camera movement. Reveal only generic texture, finish, packaging and details supported by the product name; keep unknown materials neutral. Keep labels accurate and never invent cosmetic results or health claims.

styles.label: 🍓 Food & Drink Hero
styles.direction: Fresh appetizing food-commercial styling with soft directional light, realistic texture and a carefully composed hero shot. Use gentle camera movement and natural-looking steam or condensation only when physically plausible and supported by the product. Do not add ingredients, toppings, servings or packaging that are not shown.

styles.label: ⚙️ Tech Product Demo
styles.direction: Clean modern technology advertisement with precise framing, controlled reflections and measured camera slides. Highlight only ports, buttons, screens and components actually visible. Keep screen content unchanged unless the user supplies exact content; no fake interfaces, extra accessories or impossible device transformations.

styles.label: 🏡 Cozy Home & Living
styles.direction: Warm inviting home-commercial atmosphere with natural window light, soft shadows and a lived-in but uncluttered setting. Keep the product as the clear hero and use believable spatial scale and contact shadows. Do not add furniture, functions or accessories that imply unprovided product features.

styles.label: 🧺 Clean Flat Lay
styles.direction: Tasteful top-down or slightly angled flat-lay presentation with balanced spacing, restrained props and a coordinated background. Keep the named product's presentation consistent in shape, color and orientation; props must remain secondary and must never imply they are included with the product.

styles.label: 🎁 Unboxing Reveal
styles.direction: A satisfying, measured reveal focused on the exact visible product and its actual packaging. Use simple, natural hand interaction only when appropriate to the product; avoid inventing box contents, seals, accessories or extra items. Finish with a clean hero composition.

styles.label: 🎨 Playful & Viral
styles.direction: Bright, upbeat short-form ad energy with a strong visual opening, playful but physically plausible camera movement and a memorable clean hero finish. Keep effects restrained and product identity stable; no chaotic transitions, misleading transformations, invented claims or excessive graphics.

styles.label: 🌱 Fresh & Natural
styles.direction: Airy natural-light product film with organic colors, soft sunlight and subtle background movement such as a gentle breeze only where appropriate. Keep the product sharply recognizable and grounded; never imply ingredients, eco-certifications or natural benefits that are not explicitly verified.

styles.label: 🔍 Studio Detail Showcase
styles.direction: Professional neutral-studio showcase using front-facing framing, gentle reframing and close-ups of visible details. Create the impression of multiple viewpoints through safe crops and camera movement, not a fabricated 360-degree rotation or unseen product surfaces.

styles.label: ⚡ Trendy Fast-Cut
styles.direction: Energetic short-form commercial rhythm using two or three clean match cuts or reframings, a striking opening composition and a clear final hero frame. Each cut must be physically plausible and the product identity must remain identical.

styles.label: 👁️ POV / First Person
styles.direction: First-person product interaction with a stable natural viewpoint and one simple action appropriate to the visible item. Avoid invented hands, extra items and unseen product angles; maintain realistic scale and movement.

styles.label: 🎭 Funny Commercial
styles.direction: Light, family-friendly visual humor built around one simple harmless situational beat, then return attention to the product. Keep actions physically plausible; do not distort, damage or transform the product.

styles.label: 😍 Reaction & Wow Factor
styles.direction: Open with a believable moment of interest or pleasant surprise if a person is visible, then reveal the exact product and one genuinely visible detail. Avoid exaggerated acting, fake testimonials, unsupported claims or distracting gestures.

styles.label: 🌇 Golden-Hour Editorial
styles.direction: Fashion-editorial composition in warm natural golden-hour light, refined color grading and gentle camera movement. Keep the stated outfit, product, person and selected environment consistent; no wardrobe changes or fabricated details.

styles.label: ✨ Creative Reveal
styles.direction: Build a memorable reveal using lighting, focus, framing or a smooth camera transition rather than changing the object itself. The product must remain identical: no morphing, teleportation, recoloring or impossible transformation.

styles.label: 👜 Handbag Hero Reveal
styles.direction: Premium handbag commercial with a clean hero reveal, graceful camera push, balanced front or three-quarter framing and a polished closing hold. Keep handles and straps plausible; do not invent material, branding or hardware.

styles.label: 🔎 Bag Detail Close-Up
styles.direction: Slow detail-led commercial focusing on the bag silhouette and only generic visible areas such as seams, handles, edges or closure when appropriate. Do not assert material, compartments or features absent from the product name.

styles.label: 🧺 Bag Editorial Flat Lay
styles.direction: Refined overhead or three-quarter flat lay with the bag as the unmistakable hero, generous negative space, soft shadows and a gentle camera drift. Avoid props that imply included accessories.

styles.label: 🌿 Everyday Bag Lifestyle
styles.direction: Believable everyday setting with a natural, relaxed presentation of the named bag. Keep carrying posture and strap placement physically plausible; make no capacity or durability claims.

styles.label: ✨ Tabletop Bag Reveal
styles.direction: A controlled tabletop hero reveal using a gentle light change, a slow camera push and a stable final frame. Keep the bag's construction generic where the name gives no detail.

styles.label: 🎒 Sling / Crossbody Lifestyle
styles.direction: Lifestyle showcase for a sling or crossbody bag, with a natural crossbody carrying pose or a clean tabletop alternative. Keep strap placement realistic and do not invent pockets or capacity.

styles.label: 🎒 Backpack Ready-to-Go
styles.direction: Show the named backpack upright in a tidy everyday setting, using a slow camera move and a clean hero finish. Do not invent compartments, laptop sleeves, water resistance or included accessories.

styles.label: 👛 Luxury Wallet Macro
styles.direction: Premium wallet close-up with soft directional light, restrained reflections and a slow macro-style camera move. Do not assume leather, exact stitching, closure type or interior layout.

styles.label: 👛 Wallet Open & Close
styles.direction: A simple, plausible opening-and-closing presentation of the named wallet. Keep the interior neutral; do not invent card slots, coin pockets, compartments or capacity.

styles.label: 🧥 Everyday Wallet
styles.direction: Natural everyday-carry scene focused on the wallet itself, with a calm hand interaction or a tidy tabletop presentation. No capacity, durability or security claims.

styles.label: 🧾 Clean Wallet Flat Lay
styles.direction: Minimal overhead flat lay with the wallet as the hero, soft contact shadow and careful spacing. Do not add cards, cash or accessories unless explicitly included in the product name.
